name: Southeast Alaska & the Inside Passage
about: Cruise season and the best wildlife viewing run May–Sep, peaking Jun–Aug when small towns like Juneau are transformed by ship arrivals; most of the region has no road access at all, and winter sees tourism largely shut down.
overview: Glaciers calving straight into the sea, brown bears fishing for salmon, humpback whales, and the Inside Passage cruise route through the Tongass — America's largest national forest — the classic coastal Alaska experience, reachable only by boat or plane.
costOverview: Remoteness inflates everything here — even a casual seafood sandwich costs real money, and the marquee wildlife-viewing flights and glacier cruises are a genuine splurge most visitors budget specifically for.

specialSeasons.text: Peak cruise season — small towns like Juneau and Ketchikan see their populations multiply with daily ship arrivals.
Most cruises and lodges shut down entirely for the winter, and much of the region has no road access at any time of year.
